slides.headline: Run AI models on your computer
slides.say: Did you know you can now run AI models like DeepSeek and Gemma on your computer? This is Day 1 of our exclusive 100-day series, finding the best GitHub repo for you.

slides.headline: Run AI models locally
slides.body: Download and run models like DeepSeek, Gemma, Qwen on your own device
slides.say: This tool lets you download and run AI models like DeepSeek, Gemma, and Qwen right on your own computer. No cloud needed.

slides.headline: Works with many apps
slides.body: Connects to chat apps, code editors, and custom agents via API
slides.say: It connects to chat apps like WhatsApp and Slack, code editors like VS Code, and custom agents through a simple API.

slides.headline: 182,103 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Go · Since June 2023
slides.say: It has over 180 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence. It's written in Go and it's been around since June 2023.

slides.headline: Read the license first
slides.body: MIT license allows broad use but check model terms separately
slides.say: The code uses the permissive MIT license, but each AI model you run may have its own terms. Read the README and license first.

slides.headline: Save · Share · Follow
slides.body: Comment REPO for the full list
slides.say: Loved it? Save this, and send it to a friend. Follow for the next 99 repos... or you might not see us again. Comment REPO, and I'll send you the full list, with install commands and similar repos.
